name: Casey Mize
reasoning: Mize is confirmed to start after clearing his wrist/groin scare, and beat coverage says he's 'utterly dominant lately,' posting a 2.22 FIP over his last four outings and racking up 15 whiffs on 97 pitches in his final pre-All-Star start, which supports the model's 9.5 trailing K/9 more than his raw 8.0 K/9 over 3 starts (skewed by a 3.1-inning wrist-injury exit).
